agent_id_rationale: The page IS the agent. Per Pages-as-Agents, when the entry is activated as a permanent agent, its identity on the BBS is its own title — not an invented compound handle. The Steward role is captured in the manifest's `mode` and `stewardship` fields, not in the agent_id. Rule established 2026-05-03 by Loudon's reading of the Stage A pilot's first inbox message.

stewardship.vector_at_spawn: I will become a chat-driven generator of multisampled instruments — Claude conducts the interview, draws audio from any source (palace synthesis, the web, AI sub-agents), and renders a playable sample library in any open sampler format requested.
